faq_question: Why hasn't my refund arrived?
answer: Check the original payment method and the merchant's refund confirmation first. Refund timing depends on the merchant, payment provider, and bank. If the expected timeframe has passed, contact the merchant for the refund reference and ask your bank to trace it. This is general guidance; the actual timeframe depends on your provider.

faq_question: How do I activate my bank card?
answer: Open your bank's official app or follow the activation instructions supplied with the card. Some banks also allow activation through an ATM or phone service. Never share your PIN, password, or one-time passcode with someone who contacts you.

faq_question: Is there an age limit for opening an account?
answer: Minimum age requirements depend on the account type, country, and bank. Check the bank's official eligibility rules or contact its support team. A parent or guardian may be required for some accounts for minors.

faq_question: Can I add my card to Apple Pay or Google Pay?
answer: Check whether your bank, card type, device, and country are supported. If eligible, add the card through the wallet app and complete any verification requested by your bank. Do not share verification codes with anyone.

faq_question: Can I use my card at an ATM?
answer: ATM access depends on your card, account settings, ATM network, and location. Check your bank's app or card terms for supported ATM services, withdrawal limits, and possible fees.

faq_question: How does automatic top-up work?
answer: Automatic top-up adds funds when a configured balance or condition is reached, if your provider supports it. Review the trigger amount, funding source, limits, and any fees in your app before enabling it.

faq_question: Why hasn't my balance updated after a bank transfer?
answer: Transfers may take time to process, and weekends, holidays, cut-off times, or checks can cause delays. Check the transfer status and details in your banking app. If the expected processing window has passed, contact your bank with the transfer reference.

faq_question: Why hasn't my balance updated after a cheque or cash deposit?
answer: Deposits can take time to appear or become available, and cheque funds may be subject to a hold. Keep your receipt and check the deposit status. If the bank's stated timeframe has passed, contact the branch or support team.

faq_question: Why can't I add this transfer beneficiary?
answer: The beneficiary may fail validation because of missing or mismatched details, account restrictions, or a security check. Verify the recipient details using a trusted source and follow the bank's in-app instructions. Contact your bank if the problem continues.

faq_question: Can I cancel a bank transfer?
answer: Cancellation depends on the transfer type and whether it has already been processed. Check the transfer details for a cancellation option and contact your bank promptly if the transfer is pending. Completed transfers may not be cancellable.

faq_question: What should I do if my card is about to expire?
answer: Check whether your bank has already arranged a replacement and confirm your mailing address in the official app. If a replacement has not been issued or delivery is delayed, contact the bank through an official channel.

faq_question: Where can I use my bank card?
answer: Card acceptance depends on the card network, merchant, country, and transaction type. Check your card's terms and any travel or spending settings. If a merchant declines a supported card, ask the bank whether a restriction or authorization issue is involved.

faq_question: Where is my new card?
answer: Check the card order or delivery status in your bank's app and confirm the delivery address. Delivery times vary by provider and location. If the estimated delivery window has passed, contact your bank to check the shipment or request next steps.

faq_question: How long will card delivery take?
answer: Delivery estimates vary by bank, delivery method, and destination. Check the estimate shown when ordering or in the app. If the expected date has passed, contact the bank and ask whether tracking or a replacement order is available.

faq_question: How do I link my card to my account or app?
answer: Use the bank's official app and follow its card-linking or verification steps. Confirm the card details are entered correctly. Never send full card details or security codes through an unverified message or website.

faq_question: Why isn't my card working?
answer: Check that the card is active, not expired, and not locked, and review available funds and transaction limits. Try checking the bank app for alerts. If it still fails, contact the bank through its official support channel.

faq_question: Why was I charged a card payment fee?
answer: Fees can depend on the card terms, merchant, currency conversion, and transaction location. Review the transaction details and your bank's fee schedule. If the fee looks incorrect, ask the bank to explain or dispute it.

faq_question: I don't recognize a card payment. What should I do?
answer: If you suspect fraud, freeze or lock the card using your bank's official app if available, then contact the bank immediately to report the transaction and ask about disputing it. Do not share passwords or one-time codes.

faq_question: Why is the exchange rate on my card payment different?
answer: The rate can depend on the card network, transaction processing date, merchant conversion choice, and fees. Compare the transaction details with your card terms. Ask your bank to explain the rate and any conversion fee.

faq_question: An ATM swallowed my card. What should I do?
answer: Use the bank's official app to lock the card if possible, especially if the ATM is unfamiliar. Contact the ATM operator or your bank using an official number to ask whether the card can be recovered or must be replaced. Never accept help from strangers at the ATM.

faq_question: Why was I charged for a cash withdrawal?
answer: ATM fees may be charged by the ATM operator, your bank, or due to currency conversion or account terms. Review the transaction and fee schedule. If the charge seems wrong, contact your bank with the ATM location and transaction details.

faq_question: I don't recognize a cash withdrawal.
answer: Contact your bank immediately and report the withdrawal as unauthorized. Lock your card if possible, review recent transactions, and follow the bank's dispute process. Use official contact details and never disclose your PIN or one-time passcodes.

faq_question: How can I change my card PIN?
answer: Use the bank's official app, an eligible ATM, or another method specified by your bank. Choose a PIN that is difficult to guess and never share it. If you think someone knows your PIN, contact your bank promptly.

faq_question: I think my card details have been compromised.
answer: Lock or freeze the card using your bank's official app if available, then contact the bank immediately. Review recent transactions and ask whether the card should be replaced. Change affected credentials through official channels and never share verification codes.

faq_question: Why isn't contactless payment working?
answer: Check whether contactless is enabled, the card is active, and the terminal supports contactless payments. Some transactions require chip-and-PIN verification. If the issue continues across merchants, contact your bank.

faq_question: Can I use my account or card in another country?
answer: Supported countries and services vary by bank and account type. Check the bank's official country-support and travel guidance, including any restrictions, fees, and card settings, before travelling.

faq_question: Why was my card payment declined?
answer: A payment can be declined because of insufficient available funds, spending limits, incorrect details, security checks, merchant issues, or card restrictions. Check bank alerts and transaction settings. Contact your bank if the reason is unclear.

faq_question: Why was my ATM cash withdrawal declined?
answer: Possible reasons include insufficient available funds, withdrawal limits, an inactive or locked card, ATM limits, or a security check. Review your account and card status, then contact your bank if the issue persists.

faq_question: Why was my bank transfer declined?
answer: Check the recipient details, available balance, transfer limits, and any security notifications. The bank may require additional verification or may restrict a transfer for review. Contact your bank through an official channel if the reason is not shown.

faq_question: I don't recognize a direct debit payment.
answer: Review the merchant name and any payment agreement, then contact your bank promptly if you believe the debit is unauthorized. Ask about stopping future collections and disputing the transaction under the rules that apply to your account.

faq_question: Are there limits on disposable virtual cards?
answer: Limits depend on your bank or card provider and may include spending, merchant, transaction, or expiry restrictions. Check the virtual card details and provider terms before using it.

faq_question: How do I update my personal details?
answer: Update your details through the bank's official app, website, or branch process. Some changes may require identity verification or supporting documents. Keep your contact information current so you can receive important security alerts.

faq_question: Why was I charged a currency exchange fee?
answer: Currency conversion fees depend on your bank, card, account plan, transaction currency, and whether the merchant or ATM performed conversion. Review the fee schedule and transaction details, then ask your bank to clarify any unexpected charge.

faq_question: What exchange rate will my transaction use?
answer: The applied rate may depend on the provider, card network, transaction date, and conversion method. Check your bank's disclosed rate and fee information. The final posted amount may differ from an estimate made at purchase time.

faq_question: Can I exchange currencies in my banking app?
answer: If your provider supports in-app currency exchange, review the available currencies, quoted rate, fees, limits, and confirmation screen before approving. Availability and terms vary by bank and account.

faq_question: Why is there an extra charge on my statement?
answer: Compare the posted amount with the original receipt and check for tips, deposits, currency conversion, or a separate fee. If you still cannot identify it, contact the merchant or bank and ask about the transaction or dispute process.

faq_question: My bank transfer failed. What should I do?
answer: Check the transfer status, recipient details, and available balance. Confirm whether the funds were returned or remain pending before attempting another transfer to avoid duplication. Contact your bank with the reference if the status is unclear.

faq_question: Which traditional currencies does the account support?
answer: Supported fiat currencies depend on the bank, account type, and service. Check the official currency list in the app or provider help centre before initiating a payment or exchange.

faq_question: How do I get a disposable virtual card?
answer: If your provider offers disposable virtual cards, look for the virtual-card feature in its official app and follow the setup instructions. Check usage restrictions and remember that not all merchants or recurring payments support disposable cards.

faq_question: How can I get a physical bank card?
answer: Check the card section of your bank's official app or website for an order or replacement option. Eligibility, fees, and delivery times depend on the provider and account.

faq_question: Can I get a spare or additional card?
answer: Additional-card availability depends on your account type and bank policy. Check the app or contact your bank to learn about eligibility, fees, cardholder permissions, and spending controls.

faq_question: How do I get a virtual card?
answer: If available, create or view a virtual card in your bank's official app. Review its spending limits, supported uses, and security settings. Keep card details private and use trusted merchants.

faq_question: My bank card is lost or stolen. What should I do?
answer: Immediately lock or freeze the card in your bank's official app if possible, then report it to the bank and request a replacement. Review recent transactions for unauthorized activity. Do not wait if you suspect theft.

faq_question: My phone with my banking app was lost or stolen. What should I do?
answer: Contact your mobile provider and bank through official channels, secure or remotely lock the device if possible, and change relevant account credentials from a trusted device. Ask the bank to revoke access or sessions if needed.

faq_question: How do I order a physical card?
answer: Use the card-ordering option in your bank's official app or website, if available. Verify your delivery address and review any fee or delivery estimate before confirming.

faq_question: I forgot my banking app passcode. How can I reset it?
answer: Use the official app's recovery or reset process. The bank may require identity verification. Do not share your passcode or one-time verification codes with anyone claiming to help.

faq_question: Why is my card payment still pending?
answer: A pending card payment is an authorization that has not yet fully posted. The merchant and bank determine when it completes or releases. Check the transaction status and contact your bank if it remains pending beyond the provider's stated timeframe.

faq_question: My ATM withdrawal is pending. What should I do?
answer: Check whether cash was dispensed and keep the receipt if available. If no cash came out but the account was debited, report the issue to your bank with the ATM location, date, amount, and transaction reference. Do not assume the funds have been returned until your account confirms it.

faq_question: Why is my account top-up pending?
answer: A top-up may be pending while the payment provider or bank processes it or completes checks. Review the status and avoid repeating the payment until you know whether the first attempt completed. Contact support if it exceeds the stated processing time.

faq_question: My bank transfer is pending. What should I do?
answer: Check the transfer status, expected processing time, and recipient details. Transfers can be delayed by cut-off times, weekends, holidays, or security checks. Avoid sending a duplicate transfer until the original status is clear.

faq_question: My card PIN is blocked. How can I unblock it?
answer: Follow the instructions in your bank's official app or contact the bank to reset or unblock the PIN. Avoid repeated guesses, which may trigger further blocking. Never tell anyone your PIN.

faq_question: How can someone send money to my account?
answer: Use the receiving details provided by your bank for the relevant payment type, and share them only with the intended sender. Confirm which details and transfer rails are supported. Never share your password, PIN, or one-time passcodes to receive money.

faq_question: How do I request a refund for a card purchase?
answer: Start by contacting the merchant and keeping the receipt and correspondence. If the merchant does not resolve the issue or you suspect fraud, contact your bank to ask about its dispute process and applicable deadlines.

faq_question: Why was my card payment reversed?
answer: A reversal can occur when a merchant cancels or fails to complete an authorization, or when a transaction is adjusted. Check whether the amount is pending or posted. If the funds do not return within the provider's stated timeframe, contact your bank.

faq_question: Which cards and currencies are supported?
answer: Support depends on the provider, country, account type, card network, and service. Check the official supported-card and currency list before adding a card, making a payment, or exchanging funds.

faq_question: How do I close my bank account?
answer: Review your bank's account-closure requirements, settle pending transactions, move recurring payments, and transfer any remaining balance. Use the official closure process and ask whether fees, holds, or documentation apply.

faq_question: Is there a fee to top up by bank transfer?
answer: Fees depend on your bank, account plan, currency, and transfer method. Review the provider's fee schedule and the confirmation screen before proceeding. Ask support to explain any unexpected charge.

faq_question: Is there a fee to top up by card?
answer: Card top-up fees depend on your provider, card type, country, currency, and account plan. Check the fee information displayed before confirming and review your statement for the final amount.

faq_question: Can I top up my account with cash or a cheque?
answer: Cash and cheque top-ups are not supported by every provider. Check the bank's accepted deposit methods, locations, limits, and processing times before making a deposit.

faq_question: My account top-up failed. What should I do?
answer: Check the funding source, available funds, payment details, and any bank verification prompts. Confirm whether the amount was charged before trying again. If money was taken but the top-up did not arrive, contact the provider with the transaction reference.

faq_question: Are there limits on account top-ups?
answer: Top-up limits may apply per transaction, day, month, funding source, or account verification level. Check the limits shown in your app and contact your provider if you need clarification.

faq_question: Why was my top-up reverted?
answer: A top-up may be reversed because the payment failed, was cancelled, or did not pass provider checks. Check both the account and funding source for the final status. If the funds remain missing, contact the provider with the transaction reference.

faq_question: How do I add money using a card?
answer: If card top-ups are supported, select the add-money or top-up option in your official app, choose the card, enter the amount, and confirm the displayed details. Check fees and limits first, and never share card verification codes with another person.

faq_question: I've been charged twice for one transaction.
answer: Check whether one entry is pending and the other posted, since duplicate-looking authorizations can sometimes resolve automatically. If both charges post or the issue persists, contact the merchant and bank with dates, amounts, and receipts to request a correction or dispute.

faq_question: Why was I charged a transfer fee?
answer: Transfer fees depend on the transfer type, destination, currency, account plan, and intermediary banks. Review the fee disclosure and transaction details. Ask your bank to explain any fee you did not expect.

faq_question: How can I transfer money into my account?
answer: Use the receiving account details and supported transfer method shown by your bank. Confirm the currency, recipient information, and any limits or fees with the sender before initiating the transfer.

faq_question: The recipient hasn't received my transfer. What should I do?
answer: Confirm the recipient details and check the transfer's status and reference. Processing times vary by transfer method, destination, cut-off time, and bank. Ask your bank to trace the transfer if it is overdue; verify details securely before resending.

faq_question: How long does a bank transfer take?
answer: Transfer timing depends on the payment rail, destination, currency, bank cut-off times, weekends, holidays, and security checks. Check the estimate shown by your bank. If the transfer is overdue, contact support with its reference.

faq_question: I can't complete identity verification. What should I do?
answer: Check that your document is valid, readable, and matches the personal details on your account. Follow the official app's capture instructions and retry in suitable lighting. If verification still fails, contact the provider's official support team.

faq_question: How do I verify my identity?
answer: Follow the identity-verification steps in your bank's official app or website. You may be asked for personal details, an identity document, or a selfie. Submit documents only through verified official channels.

faq_question: Why do I need to verify the source of my funds?
answer: A financial provider may request information about where funds came from to meet legal, regulatory, or risk-control obligations. Follow the official request and submit accurate supporting documents through a secure channel. Contact the provider if you need clarification about accepted documents.

faq_question: How do I verify a top-up?
answer: Check the top-up status and follow any verification prompt in your bank's official app or from the verified payment provider. Do not share one-time passcodes with anyone. If you cannot complete verification, contact official support.

faq_question: Why isn't my virtual card working?
answer: Check that the virtual card is active, its details are current, and the transaction is within its limits and supported use. Some merchants require a physical card or additional verification. Contact your provider if the issue continues.

faq_question: Does my card support Visa or Mastercard?
answer: Check the logo on the card or the card details in your bank's official app. Supported networks depend on the provider and country. If you need a particular network, confirm availability with your bank before ordering.

faq_question: Why is the bank asking me to verify my identity?
answer: Banks may need to verify identity to protect accounts, prevent fraud, and meet legal or regulatory requirements. Follow the request only through official channels. If you doubt its legitimacy, contact the bank using contact details from its official website or app.

faq_question: The ATM gave me the wrong amount of cash. What should I do?
answer: Keep the ATM receipt if available and note the ATM location, date, time, and amount requested versus received. Report the discrepancy to your bank promptly and follow its investigation process. Do not share your PIN.

faq_question: Why was the exchange rate different for my cash withdrawal?
answer: The final rate may depend on the card network, processing date, bank fees, and whether the ATM offered its own currency conversion. Review the ATM receipt and your bank's fee disclosures, then contact your bank about any unexpected difference.
